rule.description: Every GitHub issue created by ClaudeAutoPM MUST follow the standard structure. Issues without proper structure waste AI tokens and lead to scope creep.

template.section: WHY this issue exists — problem background, current state, dependencies, environment. Must answer: what triggered this, what works/doesn't, what must exist first.
Exact file paths with change description
depends on / blocks / related to #NNN, or "None"
Concrete commands to verify (curl, kubectl, npm test, etc.)
Quality gate checkboxes — tests, deploy, PR merged

title-convention.types: feat, fix, refactor, chore, test, docs, ci

labels.label-group: true — issue is well-structured for AI execution

key-principles.principle: Acceptance Criteria over narrative — AI understands checkboxes better than prose
Explicit scope always — say what NOT to touch or AI will "improve" neighbors
Name files, classes, functions — AI should not guess project structure
Link related issues — dependencies and blockers must be visible

violations.violation: Creating issues without Context section (why it exists, current state)
Creating issues without Affected Files section
Creating issues without Definition of Done
Missing Related Issues (must list links or "None")
